places.name: Giardino Bardini
places.subtitle: A different perspective on Firenze.
places.description: Terraced gardens on the Oltrarno hillside, looking across the historic centre of Florence. Follow the broad staircase and take time to see the city from above.

photo.author: Francesco Bini
photo.attribution: Giardino bardini, terrazze della scalinata principale, 05.jpg — Francesco Bini / Wikimedia Commons / CC BY-SA 4.0. Displayed with an editorial crop.

places.name: Basilica di Santa Croce
places.subtitle: Art, history, and a quieter pause.
places.description: A Franciscan monumental complex in Florence. The Bardi Chapel preserves Giotto’s frescoes telling the story of Saint Francis.

photo.alt: Basilica di Santa Croce, Firenze, Italy
photo.author: Grueslayer
photo.attribution: ITA Firenze Basilica di Santa Croce 2.jpg — Grueslayer / Wikimedia Commons / CC BY-SA 4.0. Displayed with an editorial crop.

places.name: Piazza Santo Spirito
places.subtitle: The everyday, across the Arno.
places.description: An Oltrarno square in front of the Basilica di Santo Spirito, designed by Filippo Brunelleschi. Take a moment to look at the square and its surrounding facades.

photo.author: John Samuel
photo.attribution: Exterior view of Santo Spirito (Florence) 03.jpg — John Samuel / Wikimedia Commons / CC BY-SA 4.0. Displayed with an editorial crop.

places.name: Galleria degli Uffizi
places.subtitle: A closer look at extraordinary art.
places.description: The gallery occupies the first and second floors of the building designed by Giorgio Vasari. Its collections bring together ancient sculpture and paintings from the Middle Ages onwards.

photo.author: Arek N.
photo.attribution: Florence, Italy - panoramio (125).jpg — Arek N. / Wikimedia Commons / CC BY-SA 3.0. Displayed with an editorial crop.

places.name: Colosseo
places.subtitle: History, on an extraordinary scale.
places.description: The Flavian Amphitheatre was built in the first century CE under the Flavian emperors. This ancient Roman arena stands on Piazza del Colosseo.

photo.author: FeaturedPics
photo.attribution: Colosseo 2020.jpg — FeaturedPics / Wikimedia Commons / CC BY-SA 4.0. Displayed with an editorial crop.

places.name: Pantheon
places.subtitle: An ancient monument, still part of the city.
places.description: A Roman monument on Piazza della Rotonda, rebuilt during Hadrian’s reign. Today it is also the Basilica of Santa Maria ad Martyres.

photo.author: NikonZ7II
photo.attribution: Pantheon (Rome) - Right side and front.jpg — NikonZ7II / Wikimedia Commons / CC BY-SA 4.0. Displayed with an editorial crop.

places.name: Duomo di Milano
places.subtitle: The city, gathered around its cathedral.
places.description: Milan’s cathedral stands on Piazza del Duomo. The monumental complex also includes a museum and an archaeological area.

photo.author: Jakub Hałun
photo.attribution: 20110724 Milan Cathedral 5260.jpg — Jakub Hałun / Wikimedia Commons / CC BY-SA 4.0. Displayed with an editorial crop.

places.name: Castello Sforzesco
places.subtitle: A fortress with more to discover.
places.description: The Castello Sforzesco houses museums and collections, including the Pinacoteca and the museum of Michelangelo’s Pietà Rondanini.

photo.author: Jakub Hałun
photo.attribution: 20110725 Castello Sforzesco Milan 5557.jpg — Jakub Hałun / Wikimedia Commons / CC BY-SA 4.0. Displayed with an editorial crop.

places.name: Palazzo Ducale
places.subtitle: A different view of the lagoon.
places.description: The Doge’s Palace stands at San Marco by the Venetian waterfront. Its monumental rooms and art collections offer a starting point for discovering the city’s civic history.

photo.author: Didier Descouens
photo.attribution: (Venice) Doge's Palace facing the sea.jpg — Didier Descouens / Wikimedia Commons / CC BY-SA 4.0. Displayed with an editorial crop.

places.name: Piazza San Marco
places.subtitle: Room to pause, beside the lagoon.
places.description: Venice’s monumental square is framed by the basilica, campanile and arcades. The waterfront opens towards the lagoon.

photo.author: Matthias Süßen
photo.attribution: Piazza San Marco (Venice) at night-msu-2021-6449-.jpg — Matthias Süßen / Wikimedia Commons / CC BY-SA 4.0. Displayed with an editorial crop.

places.name: Museo Archeologico Nazionale di Napoli
places.subtitle: Ancient stories, seen up close.
places.description: Naples’ national archaeological museum includes the Farnese collection, mosaics and numismatics among its collections. A place to begin exploring the archaeology of the region.

photo.author: Mister No
photo.attribution: Museo Archeologico Nazionale di Napoli - panoramio (1).jpg — Mister No / Wikimedia Commons / CC BY 3.0. Displayed with an editorial crop.

places.name: Castel Nuovo
places.subtitle: Five towers, at the edge of the city.
places.description: Also known as Maschio Angioino, this fortress houses the Civic Museum. Five cylindrical towers frame its trapezoidal plan near Piazza Municipio.
